properties.program:
# The law of the lever: the beam tips toward the greater moment,
# and balances when mass x arm is the same on both sides.
view -55, -30, 55, 52.5

# arms in metres -> drawing units, masses -> the size of a weight
la = 9 * armA
lb = 9 * armB
sa = 3 + 1.8 * massA
sb = 3 + 1.8 * massB

Ma = massA * armA
Mb = massB * armB

# tip toward the greater moment, 16 degrees at most
tilt = -16 * (Mb - Ma) / (Ma + Mb + 0.001)
th   = tilt * 0.0174532925
c    = cos(th)
s    = sin(th)

# the beam turns about the top of the stand
py = 4
ax = -la * c
ay = py - la * s
bx =  lb * c
by = py + lb * s

# the level the beam is compared against
color "#a0a0a0"
width 0
dash "dot"
line -50, py, 50, py
dash "solid"

# the stand
color "#202020"
fill "#909090"
width 1
poly 0,py, -10,-26, 10,-26
nofill
color "#606060"
width 0.8
line -30, -26, 30, -26

# the beam
color "#202020"
width 2.4
line ax, ay, bx, by
width 1.4
point 0, py

# a weight sitting on each end
fill "#4a6fa5"
width 1
rect ax - sa/2, ay, sa, sa
rect bx - sb/2, by, sb, sb
nofill

# the numbers
align "centre", "middle"
color "#303030"
font 4.4
text -30, 36, "%.1f kg  x  %.1f m", massA, armA
text  30, 36, "%.1f kg  x  %.1f m", massB, armB
font 5.4
text -30, 28, "M = %.2f", Ma
text  30, 28, "M = %.2f", Mb

# green once it balances, red while it does not
bal = abs(Mb - Ma) < 0.05
color 0.72 - 0.60*bal, 0.20 + 0.34*bal, 0.20
font 6
text 0, 46, "%+.2f N m", Mb - Ma
